description: Defines classes for post-mortem data and call stack information within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace, including JSON serialization support.

classes.name: CallstackData
classes.description: Represents a single call stack entry with address, function, module, and line information.

classes.name: PostMortemData
classes.description: Contains post-mortem data including worker pool info and a list of call stacks.

classes.name: PostMortemData::Callstack
classes.description: Represents a call stack with an ID and a list of CallstackData entries.

methods.name: CallstackData()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing JSON container and members.

methods.name: CallstackData(const Core::callstack_info& source)
methods.description: Constructs CallstackData from a callstack_info source.
